text:
emma: Auditor asks for a compact deliverable that ties 3 prod RBAC changes to any KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events and matching k8s token activity. Prefer: CSV matrix + one representative redacted JSON per KMS event + checksums.

rachel: CSV schema proposal: change_id, pr_link, commit, actor, change_time_utc, iam_event_id, key_id, kms_event_times, k8s_audit_refs, rationale_ticket. All timestamps UTC ISO8601.

devops_matt: Splunk snippets to get me started:
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) earliest=-90d | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId
index=cloudtrail (eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy) earliest=-90d | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
I'll redact ARNs and export JSON slices.

sejal: k8s audit logs in s3://redwood-audit/k8s/prod/. I will grep for serviceAccount tokens and apiRequest user fields within +/-5m of each KMS timestamp. I’ll produce k8s_matches.csv with object refs.

auditor_tim: Please include PR diff (or terraform plan/apply excerpt), the CloudTrail event JSON for the matching IAM change and one redacted KMS event JSON per match, plus a README mapping internal IDs -> auditor labels. Checksums and manifest required.

security_bot: Reminder: use docs/compliance/evidence-manifest.md template. Manifest keys: documents, checksums, exported_by, export_time_utc.

devops_matt: I can own CloudTrail/KMS slices and put exports into /tmp/evidence_chainproof. Will target upload by 2025-04-02T17:00:00Z.

rachel: I’ll assemble CSV + manifest and compute sha256 checksums. sejal + matt, ping here when uploads ready and I’ll package.

emma: PRs to correlate: https://github.com/redwood/prod-infra/pull/6099, https://github.com/redwood/prod-infra/pull/6142, https://github.com/redwood/service-configs/pull/2278. Tagging @auditor_tim for visibility.

sejal: noted, starting k8s grep now.

auditor_tim: Thanks — once tarball and manifest are in hand I’ll validate one mapping and timestamp alignment. UTC please.

rachel: Will confirm here after packaging.
